digest.component_or_area: snapshot compaction and orphan event handling (compact_txn, fsck_repair, fsck_scan)
propositions: Natural fold operations retire and cite orphan event uuids without replaying their effects, causing repairable damage to become silently undetectable after the fold completes.
The orphan exclusion predicate must be extracted as a shared helper between fold and fsck to prevent disagreement about which pre-snapshot un-cited events are orphans.
Pre-snapshot foldable candidates must be deferred until their governing snapshot ages out of the horizon to prevent silent permanent burial under a new pre-snapshot snapshot.
Fsck --repair-snapshots must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing as fsck --repair to prevent policy drift between the two repair doors.
